job_title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer - Voice Cloning and Text-to-Speech Development
job_description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and lead the development of an AI application for our organization. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating a personal text-to-speech bot, paired with an avatar that closely resembles our CEO through the use of thousands of hours of audio recordings.

Key Responsibilities:

-Develop, test and deploy a machine learning model for voice cloning
-Create a text-to-speech application that can mimic the CEO's voice
-Collaborate with the team to integrate the voice cloning and text-to-speech technology with an avatar
-Continuously improve and optimize the voice cloning and text-to-speech technology
-Stay up to date with the latest advancements in the field and apply them to the project

Qualifications:

-Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
-Strong experience
proposal: I’m excited to help you create a realistic CEO‑voice avatar for your organization. I have proposed building a voice‑cloning engine on top of Tortoise TTS, giving me a concrete roadmap for high‑fidelity voice synthesis. In a recent audio‑AI proof‑of‑concept I built an end‑to‑end pipeline that performed speech‑to‑text, speaker segmentation and LLM‑driven summarisation, showing I can handle the full audio processing stack. My work with TensorFlow and PyTorch on deep‑learning projects, plus experience fine‑tuning large language models such as DistilBERT, equips me to develop, test and deploy a robust TTS system. I will start by analysing the CEO’s audio corpus, training a speaker‑adaptive Tortoise model, and integrating the output with a 3‑D avatar using standard WebGL APIs. Continuous improvement will be driven by automated quality metrics and regular stakeholder reviews. Let’s schedule a short call to discuss the data pipeline and timeline.
